tools.name: get_tool_pricing

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Eight market signals in one payment ($0.018 USDC): sentiment, liquidation levels, volatility, correlation, funding predictions, positioning, supply, stablecoin health. Use for a broad market snapshot; it beats four or more single calls (the parts cost $0.022). Not for one signal (call that tool) or

tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: Spot prices for BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB and XRP ($0.002 USDC). Use when you need the current price of these majors. Not for other coins, for candles (get_historical) or for on-chain prices (get_dex_vs_cex).

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Current perpetual funding rate per coin ($0.002 USDC). Use when you need what longs pay shorts right now, e.g. to judge crowding before opening a perp. Read the rate field: the long/short verdict is almost always NEUTRAL at the funding levels seen so far. For the next settlement use get_funding_pred

tools.name: get_funding_predictions
tools.description: Predicted next funding rate for the BTC, ETH and SOL perpetuals on MEXC, with confidence and time to settlement ($0.003 USDC). Use before holding a perp through a funding settlement. Each response carries the scored record of these predictions against a naive guess.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: One combined read of prices, sentiment and cross-exchange arbitrage signals ($0.003 USDC). Use for a quick general look at the market. For more signals in one payment use get_market_pulse.

tools.name: get_volatility
tools.description: Volatility, 24h range and annualised volatility for BTC, ETH and SOL from the last 24 hourly candles ($0.002 USDC). Use for position sizing or stop distances. The 24h range forecast is scored publicly; each response carries that record.

tools.name: get_liquidation_levels
tools.description: Estimated liquidation price zones at 5x, 10x and 20x leverage, long and short, for BTC, ETH and SOL ($0.003 USDC). Use to see where forced buying or selling could cluster near the price. Use the price levels and ignore riskLevel: it has read LOW in every observation so far.

tools.name: get_correlation
tools.description: 30-day price correlation for ETH/BTC, SOL/BTC and SOL/ETH ($0.002 USDC). Use for diversification or hedging decisions among these three.

tools.name: get_gas_prices
tools.description: Gas prices on Base and Ethereum with USD cost estimates, plus Solana priority fees ($0.002 USDC). Use before sending a transaction, to estimate its cost or to pick a chain.

tools.name: get_base_activity
tools.description: Base network activity: latest block, transactions per second, block gas use ($0.003 USDC). Use to check whether Base is congested before sending.

tools.name: get_defi_yields
tools.description: Top DeFi yields across protocols such as Aave, Compound, Morpho and Pendle, from DefiLlama ($0.003 USDC). Use to compare where stablecoins or majors earn yield. Not a risk assessment of those protocols.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_opportunities
tools.description: Current price spreads above 0.05% for majors between MEXC, Binance, Bybit and OKX ($0.005 USDC). Use to spot cross-exchange dislocations. Spreads are before fees and transfer time. For their history use get_arbitrage_spread_history.

tools.name: get_dex_vs_cex
tools.description: On-chain price (WBTC, WETH, wSOL via DefiLlama) against MEXC spot for BTC, ETH and SOL, with spread, age of the on-chain price and confidence ($0.005 USDC). Use to check that on-chain and exchange prices agree before trading on-chain.

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.description: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands and ATR for a trading pair ($0.003 USDC). Parameters: symbol (default BTCUSDT), interval (default 1h). Use when a strategy needs standard indicators. Not scored as a forecast.

tools.name: get_support_resistance
tools.description: Support and resistance levels from fractal analysis on 4h candles ($0.005 USDC). Parameter: symbol (default BTCUSDT). Use to place entries, stops or targets around recent structure. Not scored as a forecast.

tools.name: get_sentiment
tools.description: Market sentiment: Fear & Greed, a funding-derived component and a composite of both ($0.002 USDC). Use for the mood of the crowd right now. So far the funding term has stayed neutral, so the composite has been Fear & Greed rescaled. Each response carries the scored record of its 24h calls.

tools.name: get_stablecoin_health
tools.description: Peg check for USDC and DAI plus the ten largest stablecoins by market cap ($0.002 USDC). Use before holding or routing funds through a stablecoin, or when a depeg is rumoured.

tools.name: get_historical
tools.description: Historical OHLCV candles for a trading pair ($0.010 USDC). Parameters: symbol (default BTCUSDT), interval 1m to 1d, limit up to 500. Use for backtests or charts. Not for derived signals (get_signal_history_7d).

tools.name: get_positioning
tools.description: Trader positioning per coin: open interest, long/short ratios of all accounts and of top traders, and funding, from Binance and CoinEx, hourly ($0.005 USDC). Use to judge whether one side is crowded.

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Daily net flows of US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs in USD millions, latest trading day plus 30 days ($0.005 USDC). Use for institutional demand. Updated once per trading day, so not for intraday questions.

tools.name: get_macro_onchain
tools.description: Macro and on-chain context: stablecoin supply, BTC and ETH dominance, total market cap, BTC hash rate, transactions and fees, Fear & Greed, trending coins ($0.003 USDC). Use for the big picture behind a market move.

tools.name: get_supply
tools.description: Circulating, total and max supply per major coin, plus the circulating/total ratio: how much supply is still to come ($0.003 USDC). Use to judge future dilution. Source CryptoRank; the freshness field says how long the figures have been unchanged.

tools.name: get_signal_history_7d
tools.description: Recorded hourly history of one derived signal over the last 7 days ($0.005 USDC), e.g. sentiment or funding-predictions. Use to see how a signal moved, which public sources cannot give you after the fact. Needs signal=. Only signals with a gap-free record are offered.

tools.name: get_signal_history_30d
tools.description: Recorded hourly history of one derived signal over the last 30 days ($0.012 USDC). Use for a longer view than get_signal_history_7d; same signals. Needs signal=.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spread_history
tools.description: Hourly cross-exchange spreads between MEXC, Binance, Bybit and OKX over 30 days ($0.015 USDC). Use to judge whether a current spread is unusual. Every venue publishes its own prices, but nobody else archives the spread between them.

tools.name: get_funding_accuracy
tools.description: Our funding predictions paired with the rates actually observed afterwards, over 30 days ($0.015 USDC). Use to audit get_funding_predictions in detail; the free summary is in get_signal_calibration.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_condition, get_crypto_news · Private data: get_overnight_risk_brief, get_changes_since_last_call, watch_condition, get_memecoin_risk, get_wallet_risk, check_trade, get_new_memecoins, classify_crypto_text, get_signal_calibration, get_market_pulse, get_funding_predictions, get_volatility, get_sentiment, get_signal_history_7d · Public sink: watch_condition, classify_crypto_text · Destructive: try_crypto_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_condition, get_crypto_news · Private data: get_overnight_risk_brief, get_changes_since_last_call, watch_condition, get_memecoin_risk, get_wallet_risk, check_trade, get_new_memecoins, classify_crypto_text, get_signal_calibration, get_market_pulse, get_funding_predictions, get_volatility, get_sentiment, get_signal_history_7d · Public sink: watch_condition, classify_crypto_text · Destructive: try_crypto_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
